lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Ben, do you usually go to work by motorbike?

translation.vi: Bạn có thường đi làm bằng xe máy không?

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Yes, I go by motorbike every morning.

translation.vi: Ừ, mình đi xe máy mỗi sáng.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: But the street is so busy!

gloss.en: a bike that moves without your legs
a road in a town or city
the early part of the day, before 12

grammar_notes: Adverbs of frequency like 'usually' and 'every morning' tell us how often something happens. They usually go before the main verb.
interaction_prompts: How do you usually go to work or school?
